## NĀRĀYAṆĪ DEVĪ

She was the wife of Śrī Vīrabhadra
pieces.end:
## NĀRĀYAṆĪ DEVĪ

She lived in Vṛndāvana
pieces.title: Nārāyaṇī Devī

fields.notes: Wife of Śrī Vīrabhadra Gosvāmī, son of Nityānanda Prabhu; daughter of Yadunandana Ācārya and Lakṣmī Devī; her sister Śrīdevī (Śrīmatī) was also married to Vīrabhadra. Both received dīkṣā from Jāhnavā Mātā.

pieces.find:
## NĀRĀYAṆĪ DEVĪ

She lived in Vṛndāvana
pieces.title: Nārāyaṇī Devī

fields.notes: Disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura; lived in Vṛndāvana. Wife of Gaṅgānārāyaṇa Cakravartī; daughter Viṣṇupriyā (Bhakti-ratnākara 13.252).
